description: This file defines a CalendarFragment class for an Android app, responsible for displaying a calendar view with grid layout and handling user interactions, including analytics logging and error handling.
external_files: R (resource file for layout and string resources)

classes.name: CalendarFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a calendar grid and manages calendar-related UI and interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes analytics manager when fragment is created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView, and logs calendar view event.

methods.name: updateCalendarView
methods.description: Updates the calendar display, specifically the month title based on current date.
